title: SenseAlign: Learning Decision-Aligned Predictive Representations for Active Urban Sensing with UAVs
abstract: arXiv:2611.26109v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Active urban sensing orchestrates a mobile sensor fleet to proactively inspect a dynamic road network and gather critical information for system management. This problem simultaneously requires understanding the complex spatio-temporal evolution and making decisions with partial observations. In this work, we focus on active sensing in a large-scale urban road network with utilities grounded in dynamic traffic states, while prior work has rarely considered these factors jointly. We propose \emph{SenseAlign}, a Reinforcement Learning-based (RL) framework that learns decision-aligned predictive representations for coordinating an urban sensing drone fleet. SenseAlign first trains a privileged teacher agent that exploits future ground-truth traffic for optimal sensing choices. The student agent has an auxiliary branch that learns to predict future traffic with partial observations, in addition to the RL-trained actor and critic branches. Du

translated_title: SenseAlign：面向无人机主动城市感知的决策对齐预测表征学习
translated_abstract: 主动城市感知通过调度移动传感器编队，主动巡检动态路网并为系统管理收集关键信息。该问题同时要求理解复杂的时空演化过程，以及在部分观测条件下进行决策。在本工作中，我们关注大规模城市路网中的主动感知问题，其效用建立在动态交通状态之上，而以往的研究很少将这些因素联合考虑。我们提出了SenseAlign，一个基于强化学习（RL）的框架，用于学习决策对齐的预测表征，以协调城市感知无人机编队。SenseAlign首先训练一个拥有特权信息的教师智能体，它利用未来的真实交通数据做出最优感知选择。学生智能体除了经过强化学习训练的actor和critic分支之外，还包含一个辅助分支，用于学习在部分观测条件下预测未来交通状况……
tldr: 提出基于强化学习的SenseAlign框架，通过特权教师-学生学习与决策对齐的预测表征，实现大规模城市路网中无人机编队面向动态交通状态的主动感知协调。
en_tdlr: SenseAlign is an RL-based framework that learns decision-aligned predictive representations through a privileged teacher-student paradigm to coordinate UAV fleets for active urban sensing grounded in dynamic traffic states.
